description: This file defines an abstract base class 'UiTestBase' for UI tests using NUnit framework in a Selenium WebDriver context. It manages WebDriver setup and teardown, and includes logic to support a discovery-only mode that avoids launching real browsers while still executing tests.

classes.name: UiTestBase
classes.description: Base class for UI tests that manages WebDriver setup, teardown, and discovery-only mode logic.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes settings and creates WebDriver instance if enabled.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Quits and disposes of WebDriver to clean up after tests.

methods.name: GuardDiscoveryOnly
methods.description: Ensures tests do not perform real browser actions in discovery-only mode.

calls: Assert.That(Driver, Is.Not.Null, "Driver should be created when discovery-only is disabled")
